title: The Book of 1 Kings Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 1 Kings — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.decoded: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he did not get warm.

verses.kjv: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.decoded: Therefore his servants said to him, Let a young virgin be found for my lord the king; let her stand before the king, let her take care of him, and let her lie in your arms, so that my lord the king may be warm.

verses.kjv: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.decoded: So they looked for a beautiful young woman throughout all the regions of Israel, and found Abishag, a woman from Shunem, and brought her to the king.

verses.kjv: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.decoded: The young woman was very beautiful, and she cared for the king and served him, but the king did not know her.

verses.kjv: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.decoded: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, promoted himself by saying, I will be king; and he prepared chariots and horsemen for himself, and fifty men to run ahead of him.

verses.kjv: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.decoded: And his father had never been displeased with him by saying, Why did you do that? He was also a very handsome man; and his mother gave birth to him after Absalom.

verses.kjv: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.decoded: He talked with Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they supported Adonijah and helped him.

verses.kjv: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.decoded: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David were not with Adonijah.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:
verses.decoded: And Adonijah killed sheep, oxen, and fat cattle near the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah who served the king:

verses.kjv: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.decoded: But he did not call Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or Solomon his brother.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.decoded: Therefore Nathan spoke to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon, saying, Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, is reigning, and David our lord does not know about it?

verses.kjv: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.decoded: Now then, come, let me give you advice, so that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.

verses.kjv: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.decoded: Go and go in to King David, and say to him, Did you not, my lord, O king, swear to your servant, saying, Surely Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne? Why then is Adonijah reigning?

verses.kjv: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.decoded: Look, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and support what you say.

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.decoded: Bath-sheba went into the king's private room, and the king was very old. Abishag the Shunammite was attending to the king.

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.decoded: And Bath-sheba bowed down and showed respect to the king. Then the king said, What do you want?

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.decoded: And she said to him, My lord, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, saying, Surely Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne.

verses.kjv: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
verses.decoded: And now, look, Adonijah is reigning; and now, my lord the king, you do not know it:

verses.kjv: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.decoded: He has killed oxen, fat cattle, and sheep in large numbers, and has invited all the king's sons, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army; but he has not invited Solomon, your servant.

verses.kjv: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.decoded: And you, my lord, O king, all of Israel is watching you, so that you will tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.kjv: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, when my lord the king dies, my son Solomon and I will be considered criminals.

verses.kjv: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.decoded: And, look, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

verses.kjv: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.decoded: They told the king, saying, Look, Nathan the prophet is here. When he came before the king, he bowed down with his face to the ground in front of the king.

verses.kjv: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.decoded: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, have you said, Adonijah will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne?

verses.kjv: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.decoded: Because he has come down today and has killed oxen, fat cattle, and many sheep, and has called all the king’s sons, the army commanders, and Abiathar the priest; and look, they eat and drink in front of him and say, God save King Adonijah.

verses.kjv: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.decoded: But me, yes me, your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, he has not called.

verses.kjv: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.decoded: Has my lord the king done this, and you have not told your servant who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

verses.kjv: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
verses.decoded: Then King David answered and said, "Send for Bath-sheba." And she came to the king's presence and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.decoded: And the king swore, and said, As the LORD lives, who has saved my life from all trouble,

verses.kjv: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.decoded: Just as I promised you by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Surely Solomon your son will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place; I will definitely do this today.

verses.kjv: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.decoded: Then Bath-sheba bowed down with her face to the ground, showed respect to the king, and said, May my lord King David live forever.

verses.kjv: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.decoded: King David said, "Send for Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada." They came to the king.

verses.kjv: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.decoded: The king also said to them, Take the servants of your lord with you, and have Solomon my son ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

verses.kjv: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.decoded: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there as king over Israel; and you blow the trumpet and say, God save King Solomon.

verses.kjv: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.decoded: Then you will come after him, so that he may come and sit on my throne; because he will be king instead of me, and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
verses.decoded: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, answered the king and said, Amen: may the LORD God of my lord the king say the same.

verses.kjv: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.decoded: Just as the LORD has been with my lord the king, may He also be with Solomon and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.

verses.kjv: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.decoded: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites went down and made Solomon ride on King David’s mule and brought him to Gihon.

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.decoded: And Zadok the priest took a horn filled with oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, God save King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.decoded: And all the people followed him, and the people played flutes, and rejoiced with great joy, so much that the earth shook with their sound.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.decoded: Adonijah and all the guests with him heard it after they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he asked, "Why is there this noise and commotion in the city?"

verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.decoded: While he was still speaking, Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, came. Adonijah said to him, "Come in, because you are a brave man and you bring good news."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.decoded: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Truly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

verses.kjv: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:
verses.decoded: And the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have made him ride on the king’s mule:

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.decoded: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon; and they have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city echoed. This is the noise that you have heard.

verses.kjv: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.decoded: And Solomon is also sitting on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.kjv: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.decoded: Also, the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, God make Solomon’s name greater than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne. Then the king bowed himself on the bed.

verses.kjv: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.decoded: And the king also said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who has given someone to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.

verses.kjv: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.decoded: All the guests who were with Adonijah were afraid, and they got up and each went his own way.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.decoded: And Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon, so he got up, went, and grabbed hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.decoded: And it was reported to Solomon, saying, Look, Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon because he has grabbed hold of the horns of the altar, saying, Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not kill his servant with the sword.

verses.kjv: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.decoded: And Solomon said, If he shows himself to be a worthy man, not a single hair of him will fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he will die.

verses.kjv: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.decoded: So King Solomon sent for him, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed before King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.

verses.kjv: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.decoded: As the time of David's death approached, he gave instructions to his son Solomon, saying,

verses.kjv: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.decoded: I am going the way of all the earth; be strong therefore and show yourself to be a man.

verses.kjv: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.decoded: And obey the commands of the LORD your God, to live according to his ways, to follow his laws, his commands, his rules, and his teachings, as it is written in the law of Moses, so that you may succeed in everything you do and wherever you go.

verses.kjv: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.decoded: So that the LORD may keep the promise he made about me, saying, If your children pay attention to how they live, to walk honestly before me with all their heart and with all their soul, there will never be a man missing from the throne of Israel, he said.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, you also know what Joab, the son of Zeruiah, did to me, and what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner, the son of Ner, and to Amasa, the son of Jether, whom he killed, shedding the blood of battle during times of peace, and he put the blood of battle on the belt around his waist and on the sandals on his feet.

verses.kjv: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.decoded: So act according to your wisdom, and do not allow his gray hair to go down to the grave in peace.

verses.kjv: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.decoded: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and allow them to eat at your table, because they came to me when I fled because of Absalom your brother.

verses.kjv: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.decoded: And look, you have with you Shimei, the son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, who cursed me with a terrible curse on the day I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan River, and I promised him by the LORD, saying, I will not kill you with the sword.

verses.kjv: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.decoded: So do not let him go unpunished, because you are a wise man and you know what you should do to him; but bring his gray head down to the grave in blood.

verses.kjv: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.decoded: David died and was buried in the city of David.

verses.kjv: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: David reigned over Israel for forty years: he ruled in Hebron for seven years, and he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

verses.kjv: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established and greatly expanded.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.decoded: Adonijah, the son of Haggith, came to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon. She asked him, "Are you coming in peace?" He answered, "Yes, I am coming in peace."

verses.kjv: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.decoded: He said also, I have something to say to you. And she said, Go ahead and say it.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD.
verses.decoded: And he said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel chose me to reign: however, the kingdom has been given to my brother, because it was his from the LORD.

verses.kjv: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.decoded: And now I ask you for one request, do not refuse me. And she said to him, Continue.

verses.kjv: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.decoded: And he said, Please speak to King Solomon, (because he will not refuse you,) and ask him to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.decoded: And Bath-sheba said, Okay; I will speak to the king for you.

verses.kjv: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.decoded: Bath-sheba went to King Solomon to speak to him on behalf of Adonijah. The king stood up to meet her, bowed to her, sat down on his throne, and had a seat brought for the king’s mother; she sat at his right side.

verses.kjv: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.decoded: Then she said, I want to ask you for one small favor; please do not say no to me. And the king said to her, Ask whatever you want, my mother, because I will not say no to you.

verses.kjv: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.decoded: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon answered and said to his mother, Why are you asking Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for the kingdom for him as well; for he is my older brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

verses.kjv: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.decoded: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, May God do this to me, and even more, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.decoded: So now, as the LORD lives, who has established me and placed me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me a dynasty, just as he promised, Adonijah must be executed today.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he struck him down so that he died.

verses.kjv: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the LORD God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.decoded: And the king said to Abiathar the priest, Go to Anathoth, to your own fields; because you deserve to die. But I will not kill you now, because you carried the ark of the Lord God in front of my father David, and because you suffered in everything my father suffered.

verses.kjv: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.decoded: So Solomon removed Abiathar from his position as priest to the LORD; this was to fulfill the word of the LORD, which He spoke about the family of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.kjv: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.decoded: Then news came to Joab because Joab had supported Adonijah, although he did not support Absalom. And Joab fled to the tabernacle of the LORD and grabbed hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.decoded: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the LORD's tabernacle, and look, he was beside the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go and kill him.

verses.kjv: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.decoded: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD and said to him, 'This is what the king says: Come out.' And he said, 'No; I will die here.' And Benaiah brought the king a message again, saying, 'This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.'

verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.decoded: And the king said to him, Do as he has said, attack him, and bury him; so that you may remove the innocent blood that Joab shed from me and from my father's house.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.decoded: And the LORD will make him responsible for his own blood, the one who attacked two men who were more righteous and better than he was, and killed them with the sword, without my father David knowing about it—namely, Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel's army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah's army.

verses.kjv: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
verses.decoded: Their blood will therefore come back on Joab's head, and on the head of his descendants forever; but on David, and on his descendants, and on his family, and on his throne, there will be peace forever from the LORD.

verses.kjv: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: So Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, went up, attacked him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.decoded: The king appointed Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, to take his place as commander of the army, and the king appointed Zadok the priest to take the place of Abiathar.

verses.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.decoded: The king sent for Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, live there, and do not leave that place to go anywhere else."

verses.kjv: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.decoded: For it will happen that on the day you go out and cross the Kidron brook, you will know for sure that you will definitely die; your death will be your own responsibility.

verses.kjv: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.decoded: And Shimei said to the king, The statement is good: as my lord the king has said, so your servant will do. And Shimei lived in Jerusalem for many days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
verses.decoded: At the end of three years, two of Shimei's servants ran away to Achish, son of Maachah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, "Look, your servants are in Gath."

verses.kjv: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.decoded: And Shimei got up, put a saddle on his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to look for his servants; and Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.

verses.kjv: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.decoded: Solomon was told that Shimei had left Jerusalem to go to Gath, and had returned.

verses.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.decoded: And the king sent for Shimei and said to him, Did I not make you swear by the LORD and warn you, saying, Be certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere, you will surely die? And you said to me, The message I heard is good.

verses.kjv: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.decoded: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD and the command I gave you?

verses.kjv: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.decoded: The king also said to Shimei, You know all the evil that your heart is aware of, which you did to David my father; therefore the LORD will bring your evil back upon your own head;

verses.kjv: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon will be blessed, and the throne of David will be established in the presence of the LORD forever.

verses.kjv: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.decoded: So the king ordered Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada; he went out and attacked him, and he died. And the kingdom was firmly in Solomon's control.

verses.kjv: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.decoded: Solomon formed an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, married Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he finished building his own house, the house of the LORD, and the wall around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
verses.decoded: The people only offered sacrifices on high places because there was no temple built in the name of the LORD until that time.

verses.kjv: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.decoded: Solomon loved the LORD and followed the laws of David his father. However, he offered sacrifices and burned incense on high places.

verses.kjv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.decoded: The king went to Gibeon to make a sacrifice there because that was the main high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

verses.kjv: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.decoded: In Gibeon, the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream at night and God said, Ask what I should give you.

verses.kjv: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: And Solomon said, You have shown great mercy to your servant David my father, just as he walked before you in truth, righteousness, and uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept this great kindness for him by giving him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

verses.kjv: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.decoded: And now, O LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father, and I am only a young child; I do not know how to go out or come in.

verses.kjv: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.decoded: And your servant is among your people whom you have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted.

verses.kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.decoded: So give your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, so that I can tell the difference between good and bad, because who else can judge this great nation of yours?

verses.kjv: And the speech pleased the LORD, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.decoded: And the Lord was pleased with Solomon's request.

verses.kjv: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.decoded: And God said to him, Because you have asked for this, and have not asked for yourself long life; nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies; but you have asked for yourself understanding to judge rightly;

verses.kjv: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.decoded: Look, I have done what you asked: I have given you a wise and understanding heart; there was no one like you before you, and no one like you will arise after you.

verses.kjv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
verses.decoded: And I have also given you what you did not ask for, both wealth and honor, so that there will be no king like you throughout your life.

verses.kjv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.decoded: And if you will follow my ways, to keep my laws and my commandments, just as your father David followed them, then I will lengthen your life.

verses.kjv: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.decoded: Solomon woke up, and it was a dream. Then he went to Jerusalem, stood in front of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and held a feast for all his servants.

verses.kjv: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.decoded: Then two women, who were prostitutes, came to the king and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.decoded: And one woman said, My lord, I and this woman live in the same house; and I gave birth to a child while living with her in the house.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.decoded: On the third day after I was freed, this woman was also freed; we were together, and there was no one else in the house except the two of us.

verses.kjv: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.decoded: And this woman’s child died during the night because she accidentally rolled over onto it.

verses.kjv: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.decoded: And she got up at midnight, took my son from beside me while your servant was sleeping, placed him in her arms, and put her dead child in my arms.

verses.kjv: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.decoded: And when I got up in the morning to nurse my child, look, it was dead; but when I thought about it in the morning, look, it was not my son, the one I gave birth to.

verses.kjv: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.decoded: And the other woman said, No; the living child is my son, and the dead child is your son. But the first woman said, No; the dead child is your son, and the living child is my son. They spoke like this in front of the king.

verses.kjv: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.decoded: Then the king said, One says, This is my living son, and your son is dead; and the other says, No; your son is dead, and my son is the living.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.decoded: The king said, Bring me a sword. They brought a sword to the king.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.decoded: And the king said, Cut the living child in two, and give half to one woman, and half to the other.

verses.kjv: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
verses.decoded: Then the woman who had the living child spoke to the king, because she felt deep compassion for her son, and she said, 'My lord, give her the living child, and do not kill it.' But the other woman said, 'Let the child be neither mine nor yours, but divide it.'

verses.kjv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.decoded: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and do not kill it: she is the mother of the child.

verses.kjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
verses.decoded: All Israel heard about the decision the king made, and they respected the king because they saw that God's wisdom was in him to make decisions.

verses.kjv: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.decoded: So King Solomon was the king over all Israel.

verses.kjv: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.decoded: These were the officials he had: Azariah, the son of Zadok the priest,

verses.kjv: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.decoded: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, were scribes; Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder.

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was in charge of the army, and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.

verses.kjv: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:
verses.decoded: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was in charge of the officers, and Zabud, the son of Nathan, was the chief officer and the king's friend.

verses.kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
verses.decoded: Ahishar was in charge of the royal household, and Adoniram, the son of Abda, was in charge of collecting the taxes.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.decoded: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel who supplied food for the king and his household; each officer was responsible for providing during one month of the year.

verses.kjv: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.decoded: These are their names: The son of Hur, in Mount Ephraim:

verses.kjv: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
verses.decoded: The son of Dekar was in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and in Beth-shemesh, and in Elon-beth-hanan.

verses.kjv: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.decoded: The son of Hesed was in Aruboth; Sochoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him.

verses.kjv: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.decoded: The son of Abinadab ruled over the entire region of Dor; he was married to Taphath, the daughter of Solomon.

verses.kjv: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
verses.decoded: Baana, the son of Ahilud; he was responsible for Taanach and Megiddo, and all of Beth-shean, which is near Zartanah below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even to the place beyond Jokneam:

verses.kjv: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.decoded: The son of Geber was in Ramoth-gilead; the towns of Jair, the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, also belonged to him, consisting of sixty large cities with walls and bronze bars.

verses.kjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
verses.decoded: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was in charge of Mahanaim.

verses.kjv: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.decoded: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also married Basmath, the daughter of Solomon.

verses.kjv: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.decoded: Baanah, the son of Hushai, was in Asher and in Aloth.

verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat, the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

verses.kjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.decoded: Shimei, the son of Elah, from the tribe of Benjamin:

verses.kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
verses.decoded: Geber, the son of Uri, was in the region of Gilead, which was part of the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan; and he was the only official in that land.

verses.kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.decoded: Judah and Israel were numerous, like the sand by the sea in number, eating and drinking, and celebrating joyfully.

verses.kjv: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt: they brought gifts and served Solomon throughout his entire life.

verses.kjv: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.decoded: And Solomon’s supply for one day was thirty measures of fine flour and sixty measures of meal,

verses.kjv: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.decoded: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen from the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides deer, roebucks, fallow deer, and fattened birds.

verses.kjv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.decoded: Because he ruled over the entire area on this side of the river, from Tiphsah all the way to Azzah, over all the kings on this side of the river; and he had peace all around him.

verses.kjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.decoded: Judah and Israel lived in safety, each person under their own grapevine and fig tree, from Dan to Beer-sheba, throughout all the days of Solomon.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.decoded: And Solomon had forty thousand horse stalls for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

verses.kjv: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.decoded: And those officials supplied food for King Solomon, and for everyone who came to King Solomon’s table, each person in their assigned month: they did not lack anything.

verses.kjv: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.decoded: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and camels to the place where the officers were, each man according to his assigned responsibility.

verses.kjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.decoded: God gave Solomon very great wisdom and understanding, and a generous heart, as many as the sand on the seashore.

verses.kjv: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.decoded: And Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the eastern lands and all the wisdom of Egypt.

verses.kjv: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.decoded: For he was wiser than all people; wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his reputation was known in all the surrounding nations.

verses.kjv: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.decoded: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were one thousand and five.

verses.kjv: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.decoded: And he talked about trees, from the cedar tree in Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also talked about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.

verses.kjv: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.decoded: People from all nations came to listen to Solomon's wisdom, including all the kings of the earth who had heard about his wisdom.

verses.kjv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.decoded: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent his servants to Solomon because he had heard that they had made him king instead of his father; for Hiram had always been a friend of David.

verses.kjv: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.decoded: And Solomon sent a message to Hiram, saying,

verses.kjv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.decoded: You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD his God because of the wars that surrounded him on every side, until the LORD put his enemies under his feet.

verses.kjv: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.decoded: But now the LORD my God has given me peace all around, so that there is no enemy or trouble.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.decoded: And look, I plan to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, just as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, Your son, whom I will place on your throne instead of you, he will build a house for my name.

verses.kjv: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.decoded: So now, please order them to cut cedar trees for me from Lebanon; and my workers will be with your workers. I will pay you for your workers according to whatever you decide, because you know that none of us here can cut timber as skillfully as the Sidonians.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.decoded: When Hiram heard Solomon's words, he was very happy and said, "Praise the LORD today, who has given David a wise son to rule over this great people."

verses.kjv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.decoded: And Hiram sent a message to Solomon, saying, I have thought about the things you sent to me for, and I will do everything you want regarding cedar wood and fir wood.

verses.kjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.decoded: My workers will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea, and I will transport them by sea on rafts to the place you will designate for me. I will have them unloaded there, and you will receive them. You will fulfill my request by providing food for my household.

verses.kjv: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.decoded: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees exactly as he requested.

verses.kjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.decoded: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand units of wheat as food for his household, and twenty units of pure oil: this is how Solomon gave to Hiram every year.

verses.kjv: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.decoded: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, just as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made an agreement together.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon gathered a forced labor force from all Israel; and the labor force was thirty thousand men.

verses.kjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.decoded: He sent ten thousand men to Lebanon each month in shifts: they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.decoded: And Solomon had seventy thousand men carrying loads, and eighty thousand men cutting timber in the mountains;

verses.kjv: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.decoded: In addition to the chief officers of Solomon who were in charge of the work, there were three thousand three hundred officers who supervised the workers doing the labor.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.decoded: The king gave the order, and they brought large stones, expensive stones, and cut stones to lay the foundation of the building.

verses.kjv: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.decoded: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders cut the stones, and the stonecutters prepared the timber and stones to build the house.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: It happened in the 480th year after the people of Israel came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s rule over Israel, in the month of Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.decoded: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

verses.kjv: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.decoded: The porch in front of the temple of the house was twenty cubits long, matching the width of the house; and its width in front of the house was ten cubits.

verses.kjv: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.decoded: And for the house, he made windows with narrow openings.

verses.kjv: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.decoded: He built rooms all around the walls of the house, all around the walls of the house, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made rooms all around.

verses.kjv: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.decoded: The lowest room was five cubits wide, the middle room was six cubits wide, and the third room was seven cubits wide. Outside, in the wall of the house, he made narrow ledges all around so that the beams would not be fastened into the walls of the house.

verses.kjv: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.decoded: And the house, when it was being built, was constructed from stones that were prepared before they were brought there: so that no hammer, axe, or any iron tool was heard in the house while it was being built.

verses.kjv: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.decoded: The door to the middle room was on the right side of the house, and they went up spiral stairs into the middle room, and from the middle room into the third.

verses.kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.decoded: So he built the house and completed it; and covered the house with beams and boards made of cedar.

verses.kjv: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.decoded: Then he built rooms all around the house, five cubits high, and they rested on the house with cedar wood.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
verses.decoded: And the message from the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

verses.kjv: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.decoded: About this house that you are building, if you follow my laws, obey my rules, and keep all my commandments by living according to them, then I will fulfill the promise I made to David your father.

verses.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.decoded: And I will live among the people of Israel, and I will not abandon my people Israel.

verses.kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.decoded: So Solomon built the house and completed it.

verses.kjv: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.decoded: He built the walls inside the house with cedar boards, including the floor of the house and the walls of the ceiling. He covered them on the inside with wood and covered the floor of the house with fir planks.

verses.kjv: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.decoded: He built twenty cubits on each side of the house, covering both the floor and the walls with cedar boards; he also built them inside, for the inner sanctuary, for the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.decoded: And the building, which is the temple in front of it, was forty cubits long.

verses.kjv: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.decoded: The cedar wood inside the house was carved with rounded shapes and open flowers: everything was made of cedar; no stone was visible.

verses.kjv: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.decoded: He made the inner sanctuary inside the temple to place the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.

verses.kjv: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.decoded: The inner sanctuary at the front was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He covered it with pure gold and also covered the altar made of cedar.

verses.kjv: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.decoded: So Solomon covered the inside of the house with pure gold. He made a partition with gold chains in front of the inner sanctuary, and he covered it with gold.

verses.kjv: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.decoded: He covered the entire house with gold until he had finished the whole house; he also covered the entire altar next to the inner sanctuary with gold.

verses.kjv: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.decoded: And inside the inner sanctuary, he made two cherubim from olive wood, each ten cubits tall.

verses.kjv: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.decoded: One wing of the cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing of the cherub was also five cubits long: from the farthest edge of one wing to the farthest edge of the other wing was ten cubits.

verses.kjv: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
verses.decoded: The other cherub was ten cubits tall; both cherubim were the same size and measured the same.

verses.kjv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.decoded: The height of one cherub was ten cubits, and the other cherub was the same height.

verses.kjv: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.decoded: He placed the cherubim inside the inner room, and they spread out their wings so that the wing of one touched one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the opposite wall; and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.decoded: And he covered the cherubim with gold.

verses.kjv: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.decoded: He carved all the walls of the house all around with carved images of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, both inside and outside.

verses.kjv: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.decoded: He covered the floor of the house with gold, both inside and outside.

verses.kjv: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.decoded: And for the entrance to the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood; the lintel and side posts were one-fifth of the wall.

verses.kjv: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.decoded: The two doors were also made of olive wood; and he carved on them images of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and covered them with gold, and applied gold to the cherubim and the palm trees.

verses.kjv: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
verses.decoded: He also made the doorposts of the temple out of olive wood, each being a quarter of the wall's length.

verses.kjv: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.decoded: The two doors were made of fir wood: each door had two panels that folded.

verses.kjv: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.decoded: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers on it, and covered them with gold that was fitted onto the carved work.

verses.kjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.decoded: He built the inner courtyard with three layers of cut stone and one layer of cedar beams.

verses.kjv: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
verses.decoded: In the fourth year, the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, in the month of Zif.

verses.kjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.decoded: In the eleventh year, during the month of Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was completed in all its parts and exactly as it was designed. He spent seven years building it.

verses.kjv: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.decoded: But Solomon built his own house for thirteen years, and he completed the entire house.

verses.kjv: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.decoded: He also built the house called the Forest of Lebanon; its length was one hundred cubits, its width was fifty cubits, and its height was thirty cubits, supported by four rows of cedar pillars with cedar beams resting on the pillars.

verses.kjv: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.decoded: And it was covered with cedar on top of the beams, which rested on forty-five pillars, fifteen in each row.

verses.kjv: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.decoded: There were windows arranged in three rows, with light facing light in three levels.

verses.kjv: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.decoded: All the doors and doorframes were square, along with the windows; and there were three rows of windows facing each other.

verses.kjv: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.decoded: He made a porch with pillars; its length was fifty cubits, and its width was thirty cubits. The porch was in front of them, and the other pillars and the thick beam were in front of them.

verses.kjv: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.decoded: Then he built a porch for the throne where he could judge, called the porch of judgment, and it was covered with cedar wood from one side of the floor to the other.

verses.kjv: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.decoded: And his house where he lived had another courtyard inside the porch, which was made in the same style. Solomon also built a house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married, similar to this porch.

verses.kjv: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.decoded: All of these were made of expensive stones, cut to the size of hewn stones, sawed with saws, both inside and outside, from the foundation up to the top, and also on the outside facing the large courtyard.

verses.kjv: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.decoded: The foundation was made of expensive stones, very large stones, stones measuring ten cubits, and stones measuring eight cubits.

verses.kjv: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.decoded: And above were expensive stones, cut to the same sizes as the hewn stones, and cedar wood.

verses.kjv: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
verses.decoded: The large courtyard all around was made with three rows of cut stones and one row of cedar beams, for both the inner courtyard of the house of the LORD and for the porch of the house.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.decoded: King Solomon sent for Hiram from Tyre and brought him.

verses.kjv: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.decoded: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man from Tyre who worked with bronze. He was full of wisdom, understanding, and skill to do all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all his work.

verses.kjv: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.decoded: He made two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high, and a measuring line of twelve cubits went all the way around each of them.

verses.kjv: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.decoded: He made two capitals of molten bronze to place on top of the pillars: the height of one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

verses.kjv: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.decoded: And nets made with a checker pattern, and wreaths made with chain patterns, for the capitals that were on top of the pillars; seven for one capital, and seven for the other capital.

verses.kjv: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.decoded: He made the pillars, and two rows all around on one lattice to cover the capitals on top with pomegranates; and he did the same for the other capital.

verses.kjv: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.decoded: The capitals on top of the pillars in the porch were decorated with lily designs and measured four cubits.

verses.kjv: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.decoded: The capitals on the two pillars also had pomegranates above, opposite the bulge that was next to the latticework; and there were two hundred pomegranates arranged in rows all around the other capital.

verses.kjv: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.decoded: He placed the pillars in the entrance of the temple: he set up the right pillar and named it Jachin; he set up the left pillar and named it Boaz.

verses.kjv: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.decoded: And on the top of the pillars there was a design of lilies; this completed the work on the pillars.

verses.kjv: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.decoded: He made a large basin of molten metal, measuring ten cubits from one edge to the other; it was completely round, five cubits high, and a rope thirty cubits long went all the way around it.

verses.kjv: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.decoded: And under the edge all around it there were knobs surrounding it, ten in a cubit, surrounding the basin all around: the knobs were cast in two rows when it was made.

verses.kjv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.decoded: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the large basin was placed on top of them, with all their back parts turned inward.

verses.kjv: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.decoded: It was one handbreadth thick, and its rim was made like the rim of a cup, decorated with lily flowers; it held two thousand baths.

verses.kjv: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.decoded: He made ten bronze bases; each base was four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

verses.kjv: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.decoded: The work on the bases was like this: they had edges, and the edges were between the projections.

verses.kjv: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.decoded: And on the borders between the ledges there were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a base above; and beneath the lions and oxen were certain decorations made of thin metalwork.

verses.kjv: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.decoded: Each base had four bronze wheels and bronze plates. The four corners of each base had supports. Under the basin, there were supports made by casting, located at the side of each extension.

verses.kjv: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.decoded: The opening inside the capital and above was one cubit; but the opening itself was round, matching the design of the base, one and a half cubits. Also, on the opening were carvings with their borders, square-shaped, not round.
