verses.kjv: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.decoded: And under the edges there were four wheels; and the axles of the wheels were attached to the base: and the height of a wheel was one and a half cubits.

verses.kjv: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
verses.decoded: The design of the wheels was like the design of a chariot wheel: their axles, hubs, rims, and spokes were all cast as one piece.

verses.kjv: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
verses.decoded: There were four supports under the four corners of one base, and the supports were made from the same material as the base itself.

verses.kjv: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
verses.decoded: At the top of the base, there was a circular rim half a cubit high; and on the top of the base, its ledges and its borders were the same.

verses.kjv: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.decoded: Because on the flat surfaces of its ledges, and on its edges, he carved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in their proper size, with extra decorations all around.

verses.kjv: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
verses.decoded: In this way, he made the ten bases: all of them had the same casting, the same measurement, and the same size.

verses.kjv: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.decoded: Then he made ten bronze basins: each basin held forty baths; each basin was four cubits in size; and on each of the ten bases there was one basin.

verses.kjv: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
verses.decoded: He placed five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house; and he set the sea on the right side of the house, facing east toward the south.

verses.kjv: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
verses.decoded: Hiram made the washbasins, the shovels, and the bowls. So Hiram finished making all the items that he made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
verses.decoded: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two nets, to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the pillars;

verses.kjv: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
verses.decoded: And four hundred pomegranates for the two lattices, that is, two rows of pomegranates for each lattice, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

verses.kjv: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.decoded: And the ten stands, and ten basins on the stands;

verses.kjv: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.decoded: And one large basin, and twelve oxen positioned under the basin;

verses.kjv: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
verses.decoded: The pots, the shovels, and the basins, and all these tools that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD, were made of polished bronze.

verses.kjv: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
verses.decoded: The king cast them in the Jordan plain, on the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

verses.kjv: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
verses.decoded: And Solomon did not weigh all the vessels because there were too many; also, the total weight of the bronze was not determined.

verses.kjv: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
verses.decoded: And Solomon made all the vessels that belonged to the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, on which the showbread was placed,

verses.kjv: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
verses.decoded: And the candlesticks made of pure gold, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, along with the flowers, the lamps, and the golden tongs,

verses.kjv: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
verses.decoded: And the bowls, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the censers made of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner room, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, that is, the temple.

verses.kjv: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: All the work that King Solomon did for the house of the LORD was finished. Solomon brought in the things that his father David had dedicated; he placed the silver, the gold, and the vessels among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon gathered the elders of Israel and all the leaders of the tribes, the heads of the families of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, so they could bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.kjv: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.decoded: All the men of Israel gathered together to King Solomon at the festival in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.decoded: All the leaders of Israel came, and the priests carried the ark.

verses.kjv: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.decoded: They carried up the ark of the LORD, the meeting tent, and all the holy items that were in the meeting tent; the priests and the Levites carried them up.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.decoded: King Solomon and all the people of Israel who had gathered to him were with him in front of the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen in such great numbers that they could not be counted.

verses.kjv: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.decoded: The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the temple, to the most holy place, right under the wings of the cherubim.

verses.kjv: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.decoded: Because the cherubim spread their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its carrying poles above.

verses.kjv: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
verses.decoded: They pulled out the poles so that the ends of the poles were visible inside the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not visible from outside; and they are still there today.

verses.kjv: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: There was nothing inside the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses placed there at Horeb when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
verses.decoded: It happened that when the priests came out of the holy place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

verses.kjv: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priests could not continue their service because of the cloud, since the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD's temple.

verses.kjv: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon said, The LORD said that he would live in deep darkness.

verses.kjv: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
verses.decoded: I have definitely built you a house to live in, a permanent place for you to stay forever.

verses.kjv: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
verses.decoded: Then the king turned around and blessed the entire assembly of Israel. (And the entire assembly of Israel stood up;)

verses.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
verses.decoded: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has fulfilled it with his hand, saying,

verses.kjv: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
verses.decoded: From the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I did not choose any city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for my name to be there; instead, I chose David to rule over my people Israel.

verses.kjv: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.decoded: David my father wanted to build a house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to David my father, Since it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.decoded: However, you will not build the house; but your son who will come from your body, he will build the house in my name.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the LORD has fulfilled the word that he spoke, and I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built a house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: And I have made a place there for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our ancestors when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.decoded: And Solomon stood in front of the altar of the LORD with all the people of Israel present, and he stretched out his hands toward heaven:

verses.kjv: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
verses.decoded: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above or on earth below, who keeps covenant and mercy with your servants who walk before you with all their heart:

verses.kjv: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: You have kept the promise you made to your servant David my father: you spoke it with your mouth, and you have carried it out with your hand, just as it is today.

verses.kjv: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
verses.decoded: So now, LORD God of Israel, keep the promise you made to your servant David my father, saying, 'There will always be a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel,' so that your children pay attention to their behavior and live before me as you have lived before me.

verses.kjv: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
verses.decoded: And now, O God of Israel, please let your word be confirmed, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

verses.kjv: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.decoded: But will God really live on the earth? Look, the sky and the highest heavens cannot hold you; how much less this house that I have built?

verses.kjv: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
verses.decoded: But please pay attention to the prayer of your servant and to his request, O LORD my God, and listen to the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying before you today.

verses.kjv: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
verses.decoded: May your eyes be open toward this house day and night, toward the place where you said, 'My name will be there,' so that you will listen to the prayer your servant makes toward this place.

verses.kjv: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.decoded: Listen to the prayer of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.

verses.kjv: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
verses.decoded: If anyone sins against their neighbor, and an oath is imposed on them to make them swear, and the oath comes before your altar in this house:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.decoded: Then hear in heaven, act, and judge your servants, punishing the wicked by making their own actions come back on them; and declaring the righteous to be right, giving them what they deserve according to their righteousness.

verses.kjv: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
verses.decoded: When your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you, and they turn back to you, confess your name, pray, and ask for your help in this house:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.decoded: Then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them back to the land you gave to their ancestors.

verses.kjv: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
verses.decoded: When the sky is closed and there is no rain because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place, confess your name, and turn away from their sin when you discipline them:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
verses.decoded: Then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, so that you teach them the good way they should follow, and give rain on your land, which you have given to your people as an inheritance.

verses.kjv: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
verses.decoded: If there is famine in the land, if there is disease, blight, mildew, locusts, or caterpillars; if their enemies surround them in the land of their cities; any kind of plague or any kind of sickness;

verses.kjv: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
verses.decoded: Whatever prayer and request anyone makes, or all your people Israel make, when each person realizes the trouble in their own heart and stretches out their hands toward this house:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
verses.decoded: Then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, act, and give to every person according to their actions, whose heart you know; (for you, and only you, know the hearts of all human beings;)

verses.kjv: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.decoded: So that they may respect you all the days they live in the land you gave to our ancestors.

verses.kjv: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;
verses.decoded: Also, concerning a foreigner who is not part of your people Israel, but comes from a distant country because of your name;

verses.kjv: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.decoded: (For they will hear of your great name, and of your strong hand, and of your outstretched arm;) when he comes and prays toward this house;

verses.kjv: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
verses.decoded: Listen in heaven, your dwelling place, and do everything the foreigner asks you for, so that all the people of the earth may know your name, to respect you as your people Israel do; and so they may know that this house, which I have built, is called by your name.

verses.kjv: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
verses.decoded: If your people go out to battle against their enemy, wherever you send them, and pray to the LORD facing the city you have chosen, and toward the house I have built for your name:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.decoded: Then hear their prayer and their request in heaven, and defend their case.

verses.kjv: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.decoded: If they sin against you, (because there is no one who does not sin,) and you become angry with them, and hand them over to their enemies, so that their enemies take them captive and carry them off to the enemy's land, whether near or far;

verses.kjv: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
verses.decoded: But if they remember themselves in the land where they were taken captive, and turn back, and pray to you in the land of those who took them captive, saying, We have sinned, and acted wickedly, we have done wrong;

verses.kjv: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.decoded: And so they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward their land, which you gave to their ancestors, the city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name:

verses.kjv: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.decoded: Then hear their prayer and their request in heaven, your dwelling place, and defend their case,

verses.kjv: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.decoded: And forgive your people who have sinned against you and all their offenses in which they have sinned against you, and cause those who took them captive to have compassion on them, so that they may show them mercy.

verses.kjv: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.decoded: For they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace:

verses.kjv: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
verses.decoded: So that your eyes may be open to the prayers of your servant and to the prayers of your people Israel, to listen to them in everything they ask from you.

verses.kjv: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O LORD God.
verses.decoded: For you separated them from all the people on the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke through Moses your servant when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.

verses.kjv: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.decoded: And it happened that when Solomon finished praying this entire prayer and request to the LORD, he stood up from in front of the altar of the LORD, after kneeling on his knees with his hands raised toward heaven.

verses.kjv: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.decoded: He stood up and loudly blessed the entire assembly of Israel, saying,

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verses.decoded: Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, just as he promised: not one word of all his good promises, which he promised through Moses his servant, has failed.

verses.kjv: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.decoded: The LORD our God be with us, just as he was with our ancestors; may he not abandon us or leave us.

verses.kjv: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.decoded: So that he may turn our hearts toward him, to follow all his ways, and to obey his commandments, his laws, and his rules, which he gave to our ancestors.

verses.kjv: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
verses.decoded: And let these words of mine, with which I have prayed before the LORD, be close to the LORD our God day and night, so that he may defend the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the situation requires.

verses.kjv: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.
verses.decoded: So that everyone on earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is no one else.

verses.kjv: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.decoded: So let your heart be fully committed to the LORD our God, to follow his laws and to obey his commands, just as you are doing today.

verses.kjv: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
verses.decoded: The king and all the people of Israel with him offered a sacrifice in front of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD: twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. Then the king and all the people of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.decoded: On that same day, the king made the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD holy, because there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat from the peace offerings, since the bronze altar in front of the LORD was too small to hold the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat from the peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
verses.decoded: At that time, Solomon held a celebration, and all Israel was with him, a large gathering, from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt, in the presence of the LORD our God, for seven days and seven days, a total of fourteen days.

verses.kjv: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
verses.decoded: On the eighth day, he sent the people away; they blessed the king and went to their tents joyful and happy because of all the good things the LORD had done for David his servant and for Israel his people.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
verses.decoded: It happened after Solomon finished building the house of the LORD, the king’s palace, and everything Solomon wanted to do,

verses.kjv: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.decoded: That the LORD appeared to Solomon a second time, just as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to him, I have heard your prayer and your request that you made before me: I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there always.

verses.kjv: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
verses.decoded: And if you will live before me as David your father lived, with an honest heart and uprightness, doing everything I have commanded you, and if you obey my laws and my rules:

verses.kjv: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, There will never be a man missing from the throne of Israel.

verses.kjv: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
verses.decoded: But if you or your children ever stop following me, and do not keep my commandments and laws that I have given you, but instead go and serve other gods and worship them:

verses.kjv: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
verses.decoded: Then I will remove Israel from the land I gave them; and I will reject this house, which I have made holy for my name, from my presence; and Israel will become a proverb and a warning among all nations.

verses.kjv: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.decoded: And at this house, which is tall, everyone who passes by it will be amazed and will hiss; and they will say, Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?

verses.kjv: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
verses.decoded: And they will answer, Because they abandoned the LORD their God, who brought their ancestors out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold of other gods, and have worshiped them, and served them: therefore the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king’s house,
verses.decoded: After twenty years had passed, when Solomon had finished building the two buildings, the house of the LORD and the king’s palace,

verses.kjv: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.decoded: Now Hiram, the king of Tyre, had supplied Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his request, so then King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

verses.kjv: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.decoded: Hiram came from Tyre to see the cities that Solomon had given him, but he did not like them.

verses.kjv: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.decoded: And he said, What cities are these that you have given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul to this day.

verses.kjv: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.decoded: And Hiram sent to the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold.

verses.kjv: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.decoded: And this is the reason for the forced labor that King Solomon imposed: to build the house of the LORD, his own palace, the Millo, the wall of Jerusalem, and the cities Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.kjv: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.decoded: Because Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had come up, captured Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites living in the city, and gave it as a gift to his daughter, who was Solomon’s wife.

verses.kjv: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
verses.decoded: And Solomon built Gezer, and Lower Beth-horon,

verses.kjv: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.decoded: and Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, in the country,

verses.kjv: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.decoded: And all the storage cities that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and whatever Solomon wanted to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land he ruled.

verses.kjv: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
verses.decoded: And all the people who remained from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who were not Israelites,

verses.kjv: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.decoded: The children who remained in the land after them, whom the children of Israel were also unable to completely destroy, Solomon forced those people to pay a tax of forced labor to this day.

verses.kjv: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.decoded: But Solomon did not make any of the children of Israel slaves; instead, they were soldiers, his servants, his officials, his commanders, and leaders of his chariots and horsemen.

verses.kjv: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.decoded: These were the leaders of the officers who were in charge of Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty in number, who ruled over the people who worked on the project.

verses.kjv: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.decoded: But Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the city of David to her house that Solomon had built for her; then he built Millo.

verses.kjv: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
verses.decoded: Three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he built for the LORD, and he burned incense on the altar in front of the LORD. In this way, he completed the house.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth, on the coast of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.decoded: And Hiram sent his servants, sailors who knew the sea, with the servants of Solomon in the navy.

verses.kjv: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
verses.decoded: They went to Ophir and brought back four hundred and twenty talents of gold from there, and they gave it to King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.decoded: When the queen of Sheba heard about Solomon's reputation because of the LORD's name, she came to test him with difficult questions.

verses.kjv: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.decoded: And she came to Jerusalem with a very large group, with camels carrying spices, a lot of gold, and precious stones; and when she arrived to see Solomon, she talked with him about everything on her mind.

verses.kjv: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.decoded: And Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing hidden from the king that he did not explain to her.

verses.kjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.decoded: When the queen of Sheba saw all of Solomon’s wisdom and the house he had built,

verses.kjv: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.decoded: The food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his officials, their clothing, his cupbearers, and the way he went up to the house of the LORD—she had no more spirit left.

verses.kjv: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
verses.decoded: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own country about your deeds and your wisdom.

verses.kjv: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.decoded: However, I did not believe the words until I came and saw it with my own eyes; and, look, I was not even told half of it: your wisdom and success are greater than the reputation I heard.

verses.kjv: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
verses.decoded: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and listen to your wisdom.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.decoded: Blessed be the LORD your God, who was pleased with you and set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, he made you king to carry out judgment and justice.

verses.kjv: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.decoded: And she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, a very large quantity of spices, and precious stones. There was never a greater amount of spices than those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.kjv: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.decoded: The navy of Hiram, which brought gold from Ophir, also brought a large amount of almug trees and precious stones from Ophir.

verses.kjv: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.decoded: The king made pillars for the house of the LORD from the almug trees, and for the king’s house, he also made harps and psalteries for the singers. No such almug trees have come or been seen up to this day.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she wanted, whatever she asked for, in addition to what Solomon gave her from his royal wealth. Then she turned and returned to her own country, along with her servants.

verses.kjv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.decoded: The amount of gold that Solomon received in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold.

verses.kjv: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.decoded: In addition to that, he received from the merchants, from the trade of the spice merchants, from all the kings of Arabia, and from the governors of the land.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
verses.decoded: And King Solomon made two hundred shields of hammered gold; each shield weighed six hundred shekels of gold.

verses.kjv: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: He made three hundred shields out of beaten gold; each shield required three pounds of gold. The king placed them in the house called the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.decoded: Also, the king made a large throne out of ivory and covered it with the finest gold.

verses.kjv: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.decoded: The throne had six steps, and the back of the throne was rounded; there were supports on each side of the seat, and two lions stood beside the supports.

verses.kjv: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.decoded: Twelve lions stood there on one side and on the other side on the six steps; nothing like this was made in any kingdom.

verses.kjv: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.decoded: All of King Solomon’s drinking cups were made of gold, and all the containers in the house of the forest of Lebanon were made of pure gold; none were made of silver: silver was considered worthless during Solomon’s reign.

verses.kjv: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.decoded: The king had a fleet of ships from Tarshish at sea along with the fleet of Hiram. Every three years, the fleet from Tarshish would arrive, bringing gold, silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.

verses.kjv: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.decoded: So King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.

verses.kjv: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.decoded: Everyone on earth came to Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had given him.

verses.kjv: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.decoded: And each man brought his gift: silver vessels, gold vessels, clothes, armor, spices, horses, and mules, as a regular yearly tribute.

verses.kjv: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Solomon collected chariots and horsemen: he had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, whom he stationed in the cities for the chariots, and with the king in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
verses.decoded: The king caused silver to be as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars as plentiful as the sycamore trees that grow in the valley.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.decoded: And Solomon imported horses from Egypt, along with linen yarn; the king’s merchants bought the linen yarn for a price.

verses.kjv: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.decoded: A chariot was brought up and taken out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred and fifty shekels; and in this way they brought them out for all the kings of the Hittites and for the kings of Syria.

verses.kjv: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
verses.decoded: But King Solomon loved many foreign women, including the daughter of Pharaoh, and women from the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites.

verses.kjv: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.decoded: Of the nations about which the LORD said to the children of Israel, You must not go among them, nor should they come among you, because they will certainly turn your heart away to follow their gods. Solomon loved these nations.

verses.kjv: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.decoded: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines, and his wives turned his heart away.

verses.kjv: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.decoded: When Solomon grew old, his wives caused his heart to turn away to other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God, like the heart of David his father.

verses.kjv: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.decoded: Solomon followed Ashtoreth, the goddess worshiped by the Zidonians, and Milcom, the detestable god of the Ammonites.

verses.kjv: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.decoded: Solomon did what was wrong in the eyes of the LORD and did not follow the LORD completely like his father David did.

verses.kjv: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, the detestable god of Moab, on the hill in front of Jerusalem, and also for Molech, the detestable god of the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.decoded: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.

verses.kjv: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.decoded: The LORD was angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the LORD God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

verses.kjv: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
verses.decoded: And had commanded him about this, that he should not follow other gods; but he did not keep what the LORD commanded.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.decoded: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, Because you have done this and have not kept my covenant and my laws, which I commanded you, I will certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.decoded: However, during your lifetime I will not do it because of David your father’s sake, but I will take it away from your son’s control.

verses.kjv: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
verses.decoded: However, I will not take away the entire kingdom; instead, I will give one tribe to your son because of David my servant, and because of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen.

verses.kjv: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.
verses.decoded: And the LORD caused an enemy to rise against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was from the royal family in Edom.

verses.kjv: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.decoded: It happened when David was in Edom, and Joab, the commander of the army, had gone up to bury the dead after he had killed every male in Edom;

verses.kjv: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.decoded: Joab stayed there with all Israel for six months until he had killed every male in Edom.

verses.kjv: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.decoded: Hadad fled, and some Edomites who were servants of his father went with him to Egypt; Hadad was still a young child.

verses.kjv: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.decoded: They left Midian and went to Paran. They took some men from Paran with them and went to Egypt to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. Pharaoh gave him a house, provided him with food, and gave him land.

verses.kjv: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.decoded: Hadad found great favor in Pharaoh's eyes, so Pharaoh gave him as a wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Queen Tahpenes.

verses.kjv: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.decoded: The sister of Tahpenes gave birth to Genubath, his son, whom Tahpenes raised in Pharaoh’s house. Genubath lived in Pharaoh’s household among Pharaoh’s sons.

verses.kjv: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.decoded: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had died and that Joab, the commander of the army, was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me leave so I can go back to my own country."

verses.kjv: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.decoded: Then Pharaoh said to him, But what have you lacked with me, that you are now trying to go to your own country? And he answered, Nothing: however, please let me go anyway.

verses.kjv: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.decoded: And God caused another enemy to rise against him, Rezon the son of Eliadah, who had escaped from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah:

verses.kjv: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.decoded: He gathered men to himself and became the leader of a group when David killed the people of Zobah. Then they went to Damascus, lived there, and ruled in Damascus.

verses.kjv: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.decoded: He was an enemy to Israel throughout Solomon's entire reign, in addition to the harm that Hadad caused. He hated Israel and ruled over Syria.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.decoded: Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite from Zereda, who was a servant of Solomon and whose mother was Zeruah, a widow, rebelled against the king.

verses.kjv: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.decoded: And this was the reason he rebelled against the king: Solomon built Millo and fixed the broken walls of the city of David his father.

verses.kjv: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.decoded: Jeroboam was a strong and courageous man. When Solomon saw that the young man was hardworking, he appointed him to be in charge of all the affairs of the house of Joseph.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.decoded: At that time, when Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh met him on the road. Ahijah was wearing a new piece of clothing, and the two of them were alone in the countryside.

verses.kjv: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.decoded: And Ahijah grabbed the new garment he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces:

verses.kjv: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.decoded: And he said to Jeroboam, Take ten pieces for yourself, because the LORD, the God of Israel, says, Look, I will tear the kingdom out of Solomon's hand and give ten tribes to you.

verses.kjv: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.decoded: But he will have one tribe because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.decoded: Because they have abandoned me and have worshiped Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh, the god of the Moabites, and Milcom, the god of the children of Ammon, and have not followed my ways to do what is right in my eyes and to obey my laws and my rules, as David his father did.

verses.kjv: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.decoded: However, I will not take the entire kingdom away from him; instead, I will make him ruler for all the days of his life because of David my servant, whom I chose because he obeyed my commandments and my laws.

verses.kjv: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.decoded: But I will take the kingdom away from his son’s control, and I will give it to you, even ten tribes.

verses.kjv: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.decoded: And I will give one tribe to his son, so that David my servant will always have a light before me in Jerusalem, the city I have chosen to place my name.

verses.kjv: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.decoded: And I will take you, and you will reign according to everything your soul desires, and you will be king over Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, if you listen to everything I command you, and follow my ways, and do what is right in my sight, keeping my laws and my commands, just as David my servant did; then I will be with you, and build you a secure dynasty, just as I built one for David, and I will give Israel to you.

verses.kjv: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.decoded: And because of this, I will punish the descendants of David, but not forever.

verses.kjv: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.decoded: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam. So Jeroboam got up and escaped to Egypt, to Shishak, the king of Egypt, and stayed in Egypt until Solomon died.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.decoded: The other events of Solomon's reign, everything he did, and his wisdom, are they not recorded in the book of Solomon's deeds?

verses.kjv: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.decoded: Solomon ruled over all Israel in Jerusalem for forty years.

verses.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Solomon died and was buried in the city of David his father; and his son Rehoboam became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.decoded: Rehoboam went to Shechem because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.decoded: It happened that when Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who was still in Egypt, heard about it, (because he had fled from King Solomon's presence, and Jeroboam was living in Egypt;)

verses.kjv: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.decoded: They sent for him. Jeroboam and all the people of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.kjv: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.decoded: Your father made our burden hard to bear; now then, make the hard service your father imposed on us and the heavy burden he placed on us lighter, and we will serve you.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Leave for three more days, then come back to me. And the people left.

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
verses.decoded: And King Rehoboam asked the older men who had served Solomon his father while he was still alive, saying, How do you advise that I should answer these people?

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.decoded: And they spoke to him, saying, If you will be a servant to these people today, and serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.

verses.kjv: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
verses.decoded: But he abandoned the advice of the older men, which they had given him, and talked with the young men who had grown up with him and were in his presence.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.decoded: And he said to them, What advice do you give so that we can respond to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the burden that your father placed on us lighter?

verses.kjv: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.decoded: And the young men who grew up with him said to him, "This is what you should say to the people who spoke to you, saying, 'Your father made our burden heavy, but you make it lighter for us.' You should say to them, 'My little finger will be stronger than my father’s waist.'"

verses.kjv: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.decoded: And now, since my father put a heavy burden on you, I will make your burden even heavier: my father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions.

verses.kjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.decoded: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had arranged, saying, Come back to me on the third day.

verses.kjv: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;
verses.decoded: The king responded harshly to the people and rejected the advice that the elders gave him.

verses.kjv: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.decoded: And he spoke to them following the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your burden heavy, and I will make your burden even heavier: my father also punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.decoded: Therefore the king did not listen to the people, because the reason was from the LORD, so that he could fulfill what he had said, which the LORD spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.kjv: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.decoded: So when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, What share do we have in David? We do not have any inheritance in the son of Jesse. Go back to your tents, Israel. Now take care of your own household, David. So Israel went back to their tents.

verses.kjv: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.decoded: But the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah were ruled by Rehoboam.

verses.kjv: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the tax collection; and all Israel threw stones at him until he died. So King Rehoboam hurried to get into his chariot to escape to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.decoded: So Israel rebelled against the family of David up to this day.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.decoded: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent for him and called him to the assembly, and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.

verses.kjv: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.decoded: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he gathered all the people of Judah, along with the tribe of Benjamin, one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the people of Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon.

verses.kjv: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.decoded: But the message from God came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.decoded: Speak to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the people of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remaining people, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, You will not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel; each of you return to your own house, because this matter is from me. So they listened to the word of the LORD and returned to leave, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.decoded: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in Mount Ephraim and lived there; and he left there and built Penuel.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.decoded: And Jeroboam thought to himself, Now the kingdom will go back to the family of David:

verses.kjv: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
verses.decoded: If these people go to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, then their loyalty will return to their leader, Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.

verses.kjv: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: Then the king made a plan and made two golden calves. He said to them, "It is too difficult for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt."

verses.kjv: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.decoded: He placed one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

verses.kjv: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
verses.decoded: And this became a sin because the people went to worship before the one, even as far as Dan.

verses.kjv: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.decoded: He built a temple on a high place and appointed priests from the lowest people, who were not from the descendants of Levi.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.decoded: And Jeroboam established a festival in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, similar to the festival in Judah, and he offered sacrifices on the altar. He did the same in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made, and he appointed priests in Bethel for the high places he had created.

verses.kjv: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
verses.decoded: So he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built in Bethel on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the month he had chosen for himself; and he established a festival for the people of Israel. He offered sacrifices on the altar and burned incense.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.decoded: Look, a man of God came from Judah because the LORD told him to go to Bethel, and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

verses.kjv: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.decoded: He shouted against the altar with the message from the LORD, saying, Altar, altar, this is what the LORD says: A child will be born to the family of David, named Josiah; and on you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and human bones will be burned on you.

verses.kjv: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.decoded: And he gave a sign that same day, saying, This is the sign that the LORD has spoken; Look, the altar will be torn apart, and the ashes on it will be poured out.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.decoded: When King Jeroboam heard the message from the man of God, who had shouted against the altar in Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, 'Seize him.' But the hand he stretched out against the man of God became withered, and he could not pull it back to himself.

verses.kjv: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes spilled out from the altar, just as the sign that the man of God had given by the word of the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.decoded: And the king answered and said to the man of God, Please ask the LORD your God, and pray for me, so that my hand may be restored to me again. And the man of God prayed to the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored to him again, and became as it was before.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.decoded: And the king said to the man of God, Come home with me, rest yourself, and I will give you a reward.

verses.kjv: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.decoded: And the man of God said to the king, If you give me half of your house, I will not go in with you, nor will I eat bread or drink water in this place:

verses.kjv: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.decoded: Because the word of the LORD commanded me, saying, Do not eat bread, do not drink water, and do not return by the same road you came.

verses.kjv: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.decoded: So he took a different route and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

verses.kjv: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.decoded: There was an old prophet living in Bethel, and his sons came and told him everything the man of God had done that day in Bethel: they also told their father the words he had spoken to the king.

verses.kjv: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
