verses.decoded: And their father asked them, Which way did he go? Because his sons had seen the path the man of God from Judah took.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.decoded: And he said to his sons, Saddle the donkey for me. So they saddled the donkey for him, and he rode on it,

verses.kjv: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.decoded: He followed the man of God and found him sitting under an oak tree. He said to him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" And he said, "I am."

verses.kjv: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.decoded: Then he said to him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

verses.kjv: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.decoded: And he said, I cannot return with you, nor go in with you; I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

verses.kjv: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.decoded: Because the word of the LORD told me, You must not eat bread or drink water there, and you must not turn back to go the way you came.

verses.kjv: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.decoded: He said to him, I am also a prophet like you; and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with you into your house so that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied to him.

verses.kjv: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.decoded: So he returned with him, and ate bread in his house, and drank water.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.decoded: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back:

verses.kjv: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
verses.decoded: And he shouted to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, This is what the LORD says: Because you have disobeyed the word of the LORD and have not obeyed the command the LORD your God gave you,

verses.kjv: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.decoded: But you came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where the LORD told you not to eat bread or drink water; your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.decoded: After he had eaten bread and drunk, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.kjv: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.decoded: After he had left, a lion met him on the road and killed him; his body was left lying on the road, and the donkey stood beside it, and the lion also stood beside the body.

verses.kjv: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.decoded: Look, some men were passing by and saw the dead body lying on the road, and the lion standing next to the dead body. They went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.

verses.kjv: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
verses.decoded: When the prophet who had brought him back from the road heard about it, he said, 'That is the man of God who disobeyed the word of the LORD. Because of this, the LORD has handed him over to the lion, which has torn him apart and killed him, just as the LORD had said to him.'

verses.kjv: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.decoded: He spoke to his sons, saying, 'Put a saddle on the donkey for me.' And they put a saddle on it for him.

verses.kjv: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.decoded: He went and found his dead body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside the body; the lion had not eaten the body, nor had it harmed the donkey.

verses.kjv: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.decoded: The prophet picked up the dead body of the man of God, placed it on the donkey, and brought it back. Then the old prophet went to the city to mourn and to bury him.

verses.kjv: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.decoded: And they placed his body in his own grave; and they mourned for him, saying, "Oh no, my brother!"

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.decoded: After he buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, When I die, bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried; place my bones next to his bones.

verses.kjv: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.decoded: Because the message he shouted by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the places of worship in the cities of Samaria, will definitely happen.

verses.kjv: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.decoded: After this, Jeroboam did not turn away from his evil behavior, but again appointed some of the lowest people as priests of the high places. Whoever wanted, he made them priests, and they became priests of the high places.

verses.kjv: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: And this became a sin for the house of Jeroboam, leading to its destruction and removal from the earth.

verses.kjv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.decoded: At that time, Abijah, the son of Jeroboam, became sick.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
verses.decoded: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Get up, please, and disguise yourself so that no one knows you are Jeroboam's wife; then go to Shiloh. Look, there is Ahijah the prophet, who told me that I would be king over these people.

verses.kjv: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.decoded: Take with you ten loaves, some crackers, and a jar of honey, and go to him; he will tell you what will happen to the child.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.decoded: And Jeroboam’s wife did as she was told, got up, went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see because his eyes were weak due to his old age.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Ahijah, Look, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to ask you for something for her son because he is sick; this is what you will say to her: when she comes in, she will pretend to be another woman.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
verses.decoded: And it happened, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, wife of Jeroboam; why are you pretending to be someone else? For I am sent to you with bad news.

verses.kjv: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.decoded: Go, tell Jeroboam, This is what the LORD God of Israel says: Because I raised you up from among the people and made you leader over my people Israel,

verses.kjv: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
verses.decoded: And I took the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you; yet you have not been like my servant David, who obeyed my commandments and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes;

verses.kjv: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.decoded: But you have done more evil than all who were before you: because you have gone and made other gods for yourself, and molten images, to make me angry, and you have turned your back on me.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will bring disaster on the family of Jeroboam, and I will cut off from Jeroboam the person who urinates against the wall, and the person who is confined and left in Israel, and I will remove the rest of the family of Jeroboam, just as a man removes dung until it is all gone.

verses.kjv: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: Anyone from Jeroboam who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs; and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by birds of the air, because the LORD has said it.

verses.kjv: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
verses.decoded: Get up, then, go to your own house; and when your feet enter the city, the child will die.

verses.kjv: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.decoded: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him, because he is the only one from Jeroboam's family who will be buried, since there was some good found in him toward the LORD God of Israel in Jeroboam's family.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, the LORD will raise up a king over Israel who will destroy the family of Jeroboam on that day; but when will this happen? Even now.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
verses.decoded: Because they have made their sacred places and angered the LORD, the LORD will strike Israel like a reed shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the river.

verses.kjv: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: And he will abandon Israel because of the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned and caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
verses.decoded: And Jeroboam’s wife got up, left, and went to Tirzah; and when she reached the doorway, the child died.

verses.kjv: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.decoded: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, just as the LORD had said through his servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: The other events of Jeroboam's reign, including how he fought wars and ruled, are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jeroboam reigned for twenty-two years. Then he died and was buried with his ancestors, and his son Nadab became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.decoded: Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, ruled over Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he started to rule, and he ruled for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the LORD chose from all the tribes of Israel to place his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah, and she was an Ammonite woman.

verses.kjv: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
verses.decoded: And Judah did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and they made him jealous by the sins they committed, more than all that their ancestors had done.

verses.kjv: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
verses.decoded: Because they also built high places, statues, and sacred groves on every high hill and under every green tree.

verses.kjv: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: There were also male prostitutes in the land, and they did all the detestable things that the nations did, which the LORD had driven out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam's reign, Shishak, the king of Egypt, attacked Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.decoded: He took away the treasures from the house of the LORD and the treasures from the king’s house; he took everything. He also took all the gold shields that Solomon had made.

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.decoded: And King Rehoboam made bronze shields instead of them, and gave them to the commander of the palace guard, who was in charge of the entrance to the king’s house.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
verses.decoded: And it happened that when the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards took them and brought them back into the guardroom.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Rehoboam's reign and everything he did are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah, aren't they?

verses.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.decoded: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their entire lives.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Rehoboam died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David. His mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman. His son Abijam became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
verses.decoded: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.

verses.kjv: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.decoded: He reigned in Jerusalem for three years. His mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.kjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.decoded: He followed all the sins of his father that he had done before him, and his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God like the heart of David his father.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: However, because of David, the LORD his God gave him a descendant in Jerusalem to succeed him and to establish Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.decoded: Because David did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn away from anything he commanded him throughout his entire life, except only in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout his entire life.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.decoded: The other events of Abijam's reign and everything he did are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah. There was also war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Abijam died and was buried in the city of David; then his son Asa became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
verses.decoded: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam, king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.

verses.kjv: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.decoded: He reigned in Jerusalem for forty-one years. His mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.kjv: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.decoded: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father David did.

verses.kjv: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.decoded: He removed the male prostitutes from the land and destroyed all the idols that his ancestors had made.

verses.kjv: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
verses.decoded: He also removed Maachah his mother from being queen because she had made an idol in a grove; Asa destroyed her idol and burned it by the Kidron brook.

verses.kjv: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
verses.decoded: But the high places were not taken away; however, Asa’s heart was fully devoted to the LORD throughout his life.

verses.kjv: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.decoded: He brought into the house of the LORD the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated, including silver, gold, and vessels.

verses.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.decoded: There was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, throughout their entire reigns.

verses.kjv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.decoded: Baasha, king of Israel, attacked Judah and built Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering Asa, king of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.decoded: Then Asa took all the silver and gold that remained in the treasures of the LORD's house and the king's house, and gave them to his servants. King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived in Damascus, saying,

verses.kjv: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.decoded: There is a treaty between you and me, and between my father and your father: look, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold; come and end your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will leave me alone.

verses.kjv: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.decoded: So Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his army against the cities of Israel, and they attacked Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maachah, all of Cinneroth, and the entire land of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.decoded: When Baasha heard about this, he stopped building Ramah and lived in Tirzah.

verses.kjv: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.decoded: Then King Asa announced a decree throughout all Judah; no one was excluded: and they removed the stones of Ramah and its timber, which Baasha had used to build; and King Asa used them to build Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.

verses.kjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.decoded: The rest of all the actions of Asa, all his strength, everything he did, and the cities he built, are not they recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? However, in his old age, he became sick in his feet.

verses.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Asa died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, his father. Then his son Jehoshaphat became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.decoded: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam, started ruling over Israel in the second year of Asa, the king of Judah, and he ruled over Israel for two years.

verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, followed the path of his father, and continued in the sin that caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.decoded: Baasha, the son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar, plotted against him; Baasha attacked him at Gibbethon, a town belonging to the Philistines, because Nadab and all Israel were attacking Gibbethon.

verses.kjv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: In the third year of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha killed him and became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.decoded: When he became king, he attacked the entire family of Jeroboam; he did not leave anyone alive from Jeroboam's family until he had completely destroyed them, just as the LORD had said through his servant Ahijah from Shiloh.

verses.kjv: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
verses.decoded: Because of the sins that Jeroboam committed, and the sins he caused Israel to commit, by his actions that angered the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Nadab, everything he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.decoded: There was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, throughout their entire reigns.

verses.kjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.decoded: In the third year of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha, the son of Ahijah, began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was wrong in the eyes of the LORD, followed the path of Jeroboam, and continued in the sin that caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the message from the LORD came to Jehu, the son of Hanani, about Baasha, saying,

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.decoded: Because I lifted you up from nothing and made you leader over my people Israel, and you have followed the path of Jeroboam, causing my people Israel to sin and making me angry with their sins,

verses.kjv: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.decoded: Look, I will remove the descendants of Baasha and the descendants of his family; and I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.kjv: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.decoded: Anyone who dies of Baasha in the city will be eaten by dogs; and anyone who dies of his family in the fields will be eaten by birds of the air.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Baasha, what he did, and his power, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.decoded: Also, through the prophet Jehu, son of Hanani, the LORD's message came against Baasha and his family because of all the evil Baasha did in the LORD's sight by making him angry through his actions, by acting like the family of Jeroboam, and because he killed him.

verses.kjv: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
verses.decoded: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa, king of Judah, Elah, the son of Baasha, began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

verses.kjv: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.decoded: His servant Zimri, who was the commander of half of his chariots, plotted against him while he was in Tirzah, getting drunk in the house of Arza, the steward of his house in Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Zimri entered and struck him down, killing him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa, king of Judah, and took his place as king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.decoded: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he killed all the family of Baasha; he did not leave alive anyone who urinates against a wall, neither his relatives nor his friends.

verses.kjv: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.decoded: In this way, Zimri destroyed the entire family of Baasha, just as the LORD had spoken against Baasha through Jehu the prophet.

verses.kjv: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.decoded: Because of all the sins of Baasha and the sins of his son Elah, through which they sinned and caused Israel to sin, by provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their worthless idols.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other events of Elah's reign and everything he did are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel, aren't they?

verses.kjv: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.decoded: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa, king of Judah, Zimri ruled for seven days in Tirzah. The army was camped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.decoded: The people who were camped heard that Zimri had plotted and had also killed the king. Therefore, all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.kjv: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.decoded: Omri left Gibbethon, and all Israel went with him, and they surrounded Tirzah with an army.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
verses.decoded: When Zimri saw that the city had been captured, he went into the king’s palace and set the king’s house on fire, burning it down on himself, and he died.

verses.kjv: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: Because of the sins he committed by doing evil in the eyes of the LORD, by following the path of Jeroboam, and because of the sin he committed that caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Zimri and the betrayal he committed, aren't they recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.decoded: Then the people of Israel split into two groups: half of the people followed Tibni, the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

verses.kjv: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.decoded: But the people who followed Omri won against the people who followed Tibni, the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri became king.

verses.kjv: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.decoded: In the thirty-first year of Asa, king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel. He reigned for twelve years, six of those years in Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.decoded: He bought the hill called Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver, built a city on the hill, and named the city Samaria, after Shemer, the owner of the hill.

verses.kjv: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
verses.decoded: But Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, and he did worse than all the kings who came before him.

verses.kjv: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.decoded: Because he followed completely the path of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, and in the sin that caused Israel to sin, provoking the LORD God of Israel to become angry because of their worthless idols.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other things Omri did and the power he showed are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel, aren't they?

verses.kjv: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.decoded: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa, king of Judah, Ahab, the son of Omri, began to reign over Israel. Ahab, the son of Omri, reigned over Israel in Samaria for twenty-two years.

verses.kjv: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.
verses.decoded: Ahab, the son of Omri, did more evil in the eyes of the LORD than all the kings before him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.decoded: It happened that as if it was a small matter for him to continue in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he married Jezebel, the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Zidonians, and he went and served Baal and worshiped him.

verses.kjv: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.decoded: He built an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal, which he had constructed in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.decoded: And Ahab built a sacred grove; and Ahab caused the LORD God of Israel to be more angry than all the kings of Israel who lived before him.

verses.kjv: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: During his time, Hiel from Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundation at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, fulfilling the word of the LORD spoken through Joshua, the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.decoded: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the people living in Gilead, said to Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there will be no dew or rain during these years except by my command.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.decoded: And the message from the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.kjv: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.decoded: Go away from here, turn east, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is in front of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.decoded: You will drink water from the stream, and I have commanded the ravens to bring you food there.

verses.kjv: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.decoded: So he went and did as the LORD commanded: he went and lived by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.decoded: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank water from the stream.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.decoded: After some time, the stream dried up because there had been no rain in the land.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.decoded: And the message from the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.kjv: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.decoded: Get up, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Zidon, and live there. I have told a widow woman there to take care of you.

verses.kjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.decoded: So he got up and went to Zarephath. When he arrived at the city gate, the widow woman was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, Please get me a little water in a container so I can drink.

verses.kjv: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.decoded: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, Please bring me a piece of bread in your hand.

verses.kjv: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.decoded: And she said, As the LORD your God lives, I do not have a cake, only a handful of flour in a jar, and a little oil in a container; and I am gathering two sticks so that I can go inside and prepare it for me and my son, so that we may eat it and then die.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to her, Do not be afraid; go and do as you have said: but first make me a small cake from it, and bring it to me, and then make some for yourself and for your son.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.decoded: For this is what the LORD God of Israel says: The barrel of flour will not run out, and the jar of oil will not be empty, until the day the LORD sends rain on the earth.

verses.kjv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.decoded: And she went and did exactly as Elijah said: she, Elijah, and her household ate for many days.

verses.kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.decoded: The container of flour did not run out, and the jar of oil did not become empty, just as the LORD had promised through Elijah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.decoded: After these events, the son of the woman who owned the house became sick; his illness was so severe that he stopped breathing.

verses.kjv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.decoded: And she said to Elijah, What do I have to do with you, O man of God? Have you come to me to remind me of my sin and to kill my son?

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.decoded: And he said to her, Give me your son. And he took him from her chest, carried him up into an upper room, where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.

verses.kjv: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.decoded: And he cried out to the LORD and said, O LORD my God, have you also brought disaster on the widow I am staying with by killing her son?

verses.kjv: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.
verses.decoded: He lay on the child three times and cried out to the LORD, saying, 'O LORD my God, please let this child's life return to him.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.decoded: The LORD listened to Elijah's voice, and the child's life returned to him, and he came back to life.

verses.kjv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.decoded: And Elijah took the child, brought him down from the room into the house, and gave him to his mother. Then Elijah said, Look, your son is alive.

verses.kjv: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.
verses.decoded: And the woman said to Elijah, Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is true.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.decoded: After many days, the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.

verses.kjv: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.decoded: Elijah went to appear to Ahab. There was a severe famine in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
verses.decoded: And Ahab called Obadiah, who was the manager of his household. (Now Obadiah was very afraid of the LORD:

verses.kjv: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.decoded: At that time, when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah took one hundred prophets and hid fifty in a cave, and he gave them bread and water to eat.

verses.kjv: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.decoded: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Go throughout the land, to all the springs of water and all the streams; maybe we will find grass to keep the horses and mules alive, so that we do not lose all the animals.

verses.kjv: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.decoded: So they divided the land between them to travel through it: Ahab went one way alone, and Obadiah went another way alone.

verses.kjv: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.decoded: As Obadiah was on the road, Elijah met him; Obadiah recognized him, fell face down, and said, "Are you my lord Elijah?"

verses.kjv: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.decoded: And he answered him, I am here: go, tell your master, Look, Elijah is here.

verses.kjv: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.decoded: And he said, What have I done wrong that you would hand your servant over to Ahab to kill me?

verses.kjv: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.decoded: As the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to look for you; and when they said, 'He is not there,' he made the kingdom and nation swear that they did not find you.

verses.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.decoded: And now you say, Go, tell your master, Look, Elijah is here.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
verses.decoded: It will happen that as soon as I leave you, the Spirit of the LORD will take you to a place I do not know; and when I return and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD since I was young.

verses.kjv: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’s prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.decoded: Was it not told to my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, how I hid one hundred men who were prophets of the LORD, fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

verses.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.decoded: And now you say, Go, tell your master, Look, Elijah is here, and he will kill me.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will definitely show myself to him today.

verses.kjv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.decoded: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.decoded: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Are you the one who is causing trouble for Israel?"

verses.kjv: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.decoded: And he answered, I have not caused trouble for Israel; but you and your family have, because you have abandoned the commandments of the LORD and have followed Baalim.

verses.kjv: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.
verses.decoded: So now send and bring all Israel to me at Mount Carmel, along with the 450 prophets of Baal and the 400 prophets of the groves who eat at Jezebel’s table.

verses.kjv: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.decoded: So Ahab sent messengers to all the people of Israel and gathered the prophets together at Mount Carmel.

verses.kjv: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.decoded: Elijah came to all the people and said, How long will you hesitate between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, then follow him. The people did not say a word in response.

verses.kjv: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.decoded: Then Elijah said to the people, I alone am left as a prophet of the LORD; but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.

verses.kjv: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.decoded: So let them give us two bulls; let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it into pieces, and place it on the wood, but do not light a fire under it. I will prepare the other bull, place it on the wood, and also not light a fire under it.

verses.kjv: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.decoded: You call on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The God who answers by fire—let him be God. All the people answered and said, "That is well said."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose one bull for yourselves and prepare it first, because you are many; then call on the name of your gods, but do not light a fire under it.

verses.kjv: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.decoded: They took the young bull that was given to them, prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, 'O Baal, hear us.' But there was no sound or answer. Then they jumped on the altar that had been made.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.decoded: At noon, Elijah mocked them and said, 'Shout louder, because he is a god; maybe he is talking, or he is busy, or he is traveling, or maybe he is sleeping and needs to be awakened.'

verses.kjv: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.decoded: And they shouted loudly, and cut themselves according to their custom with knives and sharp instruments, until blood flowed over them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.decoded: It happened that after midday had passed, and they continued to prophesy until the time of the evening sacrifice, there was no voice, no one to answer, and no one paying attention.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.
verses.decoded: Elijah said to all the people, Come close to me. And all the people came close to him. Then he repaired the altar of the LORD that had been broken down.

verses.kjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.decoded: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel will be your name.

verses.kjv: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.decoded: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD, and he made a trench around the altar large enough to hold two measures of seed.

verses.kjv: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.decoded: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces, placed it on the wood, and said, 'Fill four containers with water and pour it over the burnt offering and the wood.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.decoded: He said, Do it a second time. They did it a second time. Then he said, Do it a third time. They did it a third time.

verses.kjv: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.decoded: The water flowed all around the altar; and he also filled the ditch with water.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.decoded: At the time of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet came near and said, 'LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel, and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things by your command.'

verses.kjv: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, O LORD, listen to me, so that these people may know that you are the LORD God, and that you have turned their hearts back again.

verses.kjv: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.decoded: Then the fire of the LORD came down and burned up the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, the dust, and even absorbed the water that was in the trench.

verses.kjv: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.
verses.decoded: When all the people saw it, they fell face down and said, The LORD is God; the LORD is God.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to them, Capture the prophets of Baal; do not let any of them escape. So they captured them, and Elijah brought them down to the Kishon brook and killed them there.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to Ahab, Get up, eat and drink; because there is the sound of heavy rain.

verses.kjv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.decoded: So Ahab went inside to eat and drink. Elijah went to the top of Mount Carmel, lay down on the ground, and put his face between his knees.

verses.kjv: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.decoded: He said to his servant, 'Go up now, look toward the sea.' The servant went up, looked, and said, 'There is nothing.' He said, 'Go back and look again seven times.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verses.decoded: At the seventh time, he said, Look, a small cloud is rising from the sea, about the size of a man's hand. Then he said, Go and tell Ahab, Get your chariot ready and go down so the rain does not stop you.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.decoded: At the same time, the sky became dark with clouds and wind, and there was a heavy rain. Ahab rode his horse and went to Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.decoded: The power of the LORD was on Elijah; he tightened his clothes around his waist and ran ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.decoded: Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done, including how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

verses.kjv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.decoded: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, May the gods do to me and even worse if I do not make your life like the life of one of them by this time tomorrow.

verses.kjv: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.decoded: When he saw that, he got up and ran for his life, and went to Beer-sheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

verses.kjv: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
verses.decoded: But he went alone a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. He asked that he might die, and said, "It is enough; now, LORD, take my life, for I am no better than my ancestors."

verses.kjv: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verses.decoded: While he was lying down and sleeping under a juniper tree, an angel touched him and said to him, Get up and eat.

verses.kjv: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verses.decoded: He looked and saw a bread cake baked on the coals and a container of water next to his head. He ate and drank, then lay down again.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD came again a second time, touched him, and said, Get up and eat, because the journey is too long for you.

verses.kjv: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
verses.decoded: He got up, ate and drank, and traveled with the strength from that food for forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mountain of God.

verses.kjv: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.decoded: He went to a cave and stayed there; then the word of the LORD came to him, and He said to him, 'What are you doing here, Elijah?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.decoded: And he said, I have been very passionate for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have abandoned your covenant, destroyed your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword; and I, even I alone, am left; and they are trying to kill me.

verses.kjv: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:
verses.decoded: He said, Go out and stand on the mountain in front of the LORD. Then the LORD passed by, and a powerful and strong wind tore through the mountains and shattered the rocks in front of the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind, there was an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

verses.kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.decoded: After the earthquake, there was a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a gentle, quiet voice.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.decoded: When Elijah heard this, he covered his face with his cloak, went outside, and stood at the entrance of the cave. Then a voice came to him and said, 'What are you doing here, Elijah?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.decoded: And he said, I have been very passionate for the LORD God of hosts because the children of Israel have abandoned your covenant, destroyed your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword; and I, even I alone, am left; and they are trying to kill me.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to him, Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

verses.kjv: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
verses.decoded: And you will anoint Jehu, the son of Nimshi, to be king over Israel; and you will anoint Elisha, the son of Shaphat from Abel-meholah, to be a prophet in your place.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
verses.decoded: It will happen that anyone who escapes the sword of Hazael will be killed by Jehu; and anyone who escapes the sword of Jehu will be killed by Elisha.

verses.kjv: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
verses.decoded: But I have kept seven thousand people in Israel who have not bowed their knees to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.

verses.kjv: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
verses.decoded: So he left there and found Elisha son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve pairs of oxen in front of him, and he was with the twelfth pair. Elijah walked by him and threw his cloak over him.

verses.kjv: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
verses.decoded: He left the oxen and ran after Elijah, saying, Please let me kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you. Elijah said to him, Go back again, because what have I done to you?

verses.kjv: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
verses.decoded: He returned from him, took a pair of oxen, killed them, cooked their meat using the oxen's tools, and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he got up, followed Elijah, and served him.

verses.kjv: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.decoded: Ben-hadad, the king of Syria, gathered all his army together; there were thirty-two kings with him, along with horses and chariots. He went up, surrounded Samaria, and fought against it.

verses.kjv: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
verses.decoded: And he sent messengers to Ahab, king of Israel, into the city, and said to him, This is what Ben-hadad says,

verses.kjv: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
verses.decoded: Your silver and your gold belong to me; your wives and your children, even the most beautiful ones, belong to me as well.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to what you said, I belong to you, and everything I have belongs to you.

verses.kjv: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
verses.decoded: And the messengers came again and said, This is what Ben-hadad says: Although I have sent to you, saying, You must give me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

verses.kjv: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
verses.decoded: But I will send my servants to you tomorrow around this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants; and whatever is valuable in your eyes, they will take it and carry it away.

verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land and said, Pay attention, I ask you, and see how this man is trying to cause trouble: because he sent to me asking for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I did not refuse him.

verses.kjv: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
verses.decoded: And all the elders and all the people said to him, Do not listen to him, and do not agree.

verses.kjv: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.decoded: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, I will do everything you first asked your servant to do, but this one thing I cannot do. Then the messengers left and reported back to him.

verses.kjv: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
verses.decoded: And Ben-hadad sent a message to him, saying, 'May the gods do this to me and even more, if the dust of Samaria is enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.'

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verses.decoded: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Do not let the person who puts on his armor boast as much as the one who takes it off.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
verses.decoded: When Ben-hadad heard this message, while he was drinking with the kings in the tents, he said to his servants, 'Get ready for battle.' So they prepared themselves to fight against the city.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: And look, a prophet came to Ahab king of Israel, saying, This is what the LORD says: Have you seen all this large army? Look, I will give it into your hand today; and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
verses.decoded: And Ahab asked, 'By whom?' And he said, 'This is what the LORD says: By the young men of the princes of the provinces.' Then Ahab asked, 'Who will command the battle?' And he answered, 'You.'

verses.kjv: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
verses.decoded: Then he counted the young men of the leaders of the provinces, and there were two hundred thirty-two: and after that he counted all the people, all the Israelites, and there were seven thousand.

verses.kjv: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
verses.decoded: They went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was getting drunk in the tents, along with the kings, the thirty-two kings who supported him.

verses.kjv: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
verses.decoded: The young men who were the leaders of the provinces went out first; Ben-hadad sent them out, and they reported to him, saying, 'Men have come out from Samaria.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
verses.decoded: And he said, If they have come out for peace, capture them alive; and if they have come out for war, capture them alive.

verses.kjv: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
verses.decoded: Then these young men, the leaders of the provinces, came out of the city, along with the army that followed them.

verses.kjv: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
verses.decoded: And each of them killed his opponent; the Syrians ran away, and Israel chased after them. But Ben-hadad, the king of Syria, escaped on a horse with the horsemen.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel went out and attacked the horses and chariots, and killed many of the Syrians in a great slaughter.

verses.kjv: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
verses.decoded: And the prophet came to the king of Israel and said to him, Go, strengthen yourself, pay attention, and see what you do: because at the end of the year the king of Syria will come up against you.

verses.kjv: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.decoded: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, Their gods are gods of the hills; that is why they were stronger than us; but let us fight against them on the flat ground, and we will definitely be stronger than they are.

verses.kjv: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
verses.decoded: And do this: Remove the kings, each one from his position, and put commanders in their places.

verses.kjv: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
verses.decoded: Gather an army for yourself, equal to the army you lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot; and we will fight against them on the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are. He listened to their request and did as they said.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
verses.decoded: When the year came around again, Ben-hadad counted the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel were counted, and everyone was present, and they went to fight against them. The people of Israel camped in front of them like two small flocks of young goats, but the Syrians occupied the land.
