verses.kjv: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.decoded: A man of God came and spoke to the king of Israel, saying, The LORD says, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, I will deliver all this great army into your hand, and you will know that I am the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
verses.decoded: They camped opposite each other for seven days. On the seventh day, the battle began, and the Israelites killed one hundred thousand Syrian foot soldiers in one day.

verses.kjv: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
verses.decoded: But the rest ran away to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of the men who were left. And Ben-hadad ran away and went into the city, into an inner room.

verses.kjv: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
verses.decoded: And his servants said to him, Look now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I ask you, put sackcloth around our waists, and ropes on our heads, and go to the king of Israel: maybe he will save your life.

verses.kjv: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
verses.decoded: So they tied sackcloth around their waists, put ropes on their heads, and went to the king of Israel, saying, 'Your servant Ben-hadad says, please let me live.' And the king said, 'Is he still alive? He is my brother.'

verses.kjv: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
verses.decoded: Now the men carefully watched to see if anything would come from him, and quickly caught it: and they said, Your brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came to him; and he made him get into the chariot.

verses.kjv: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
verses.decoded: And Ben-hadad said to him, The cities that my father took from your father, I will give back; and you will build streets for yourself in Damascus, just as my father built in Samaria. Then Ahab said, I will let you go with this agreement. So he made an agreement with him and sent him away.

verses.kjv: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
verses.decoded: And a certain man from the sons of the prophets said to his neighbor, speaking the word of the LORD, "Please hit me." But the man refused to hit him.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
verses.decoded: Then he said to him, Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, as soon as you leave me, a lion will kill you. And as soon as he left him, a lion found him and killed him.

verses.kjv: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
verses.decoded: Then he found another man and said, 'Please hit me.' And the man hit him, injuring him as he struck.

verses.kjv: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
verses.decoded: So the prophet left and waited for the king along the road, and he covered his face with ashes to disguise himself.

verses.kjv: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
verses.decoded: As the king was passing by, he shouted to the king and said, 'Your servant went out into the middle of the battle, and look, a man turned aside and brought a man to me and said, "Keep this man. If he is missing in any way, then your life will be for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver."'

verses.kjv: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
verses.decoded: And while your servant was busy here and there, he disappeared. Then the king of Israel said to him, This will be your punishment; you have decided it yourself.

verses.kjv: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
verses.decoded: He hurried and wiped the ashes off his face; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, This is what the LORD says: Because you have allowed a man I appointed for complete destruction to escape from your hand, your life will be given in exchange for his life, and your people in exchange for his people.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel went to his house feeling sad and unhappy, and then he went to Samaria.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.decoded: After these events, Naboth the Jezreelite owned a vineyard located in Jezreel, right next to the palace of Ahab, the king of Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
verses.decoded: And Ahab said to Naboth, "Give me your vineyard so I can use it as a vegetable garden because it is close to my house. I will give you a better vineyard in exchange for it; or, if you prefer, I will pay you the value of it in money."

verses.kjv: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
verses.decoded: And Naboth said to Ahab, May the LORD forbid me to give the inheritance of my ancestors to you.

verses.kjv: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
verses.decoded: And Ahab went into his house feeling sad and upset because of what Naboth the Jezreelite had said to him: because Naboth had said, I will not give you the inheritance of my ancestors. Then Ahab lay down on his bed, turned his face away, and refused to eat any food.

verses.kjv: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
verses.decoded: But Jezebel his wife came to him and said, Why is your spirit so sad that you are not eating any bread?

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
verses.decoded: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, Give me your vineyard for money; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in exchange: and he answered, I will not give you my vineyard.

verses.kjv: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.decoded: And Jezebel his wife said to him, Do you now rule the kingdom of Israel? Get up, eat some food, and let your heart be glad: I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.kjv: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
verses.decoded: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and nobles living in his city, where Naboth lived.

verses.kjv: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
verses.decoded: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Announce a fast, and place Naboth in a prominent position among the people:

verses.kjv: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
verses.decoded: And place two worthless men in front of him to testify against him, saying, You have blasphemed God and the king. Then take him outside and stone him to death.

verses.kjv: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
verses.decoded: The men of his city, including the elders and the nobles who lived there, did exactly what Jezebel had instructed them to do, following the instructions written in the letters she had sent.

verses.kjv: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.decoded: They announced a fast and placed Naboth in a prominent position among the people.

verses.kjv: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
verses.decoded: Then two worthless men came in and sat in front of him. These worthless men testified against Naboth in front of the people, saying, 'Naboth has spoken evil against God and the king.' So they took him outside the city and threw stones at him until he died.

verses.kjv: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
verses.decoded: Then they sent a message to Jezebel, saying, Naboth has been stoned and is dead.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
verses.decoded: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, she said to Ahab, "Get up and take possession of Naboth the Jezreelite's vineyard, which he refused to sell to you for money, because Naboth is no longer alive but dead."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.decoded: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to Naboth the Jezreelite's vineyard to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.kjv: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
verses.decoded: Get up and go down to meet Ahab, king of Israel, who is in Samaria; look, he is in Naboth's vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
verses.decoded: And you will speak to him, saying, This is what the LORD says: Did you kill and also take possession? And you will speak to him, saying, This is what the LORD says: In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will also lick your blood, yes, yours.

verses.kjv: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.decoded: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you found me, my enemy? And he answered, I have found you because you have devoted yourself to doing evil in the sight of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring disaster upon you, and I will take away your descendants, and I will cut off from Ahab the one who urinates against the wall, and the one who is confined and left in Israel,

verses.kjv: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: And I will destroy your family like the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and like the family of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have angered me and caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
verses.decoded: The LORD also spoke about Jezebel, saying, The dogs will eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

verses.kjv: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.decoded: The one who dies of Ahab in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one who dies in the field, the birds of the air will eat.

verses.kjv: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
verses.decoded: But there was no one like Ahab, who completely devoted himself to doing evil in the sight of the LORD, because Jezebel his wife encouraged him.

verses.kjv: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He acted very wickedly by following idols in every way, just like the Amorites did, whom the LORD had driven out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
verses.decoded: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth over his skin, fasted, lay down in sackcloth, and walked quietly.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the message from the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.kjv: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.
verses.decoded: Do you see how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring disaster during his lifetime, but I will bring disaster on his family during his son's lifetime.

verses.kjv: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.decoded: They went on for three years without any war between Syria and Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.decoded: In the third year, Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, went to visit the king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.decoded: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do you know that Ramoth in Gilead belongs to us, but we are doing nothing and have not taken it from the hand of the king of Syria?

verses.kjv: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.decoded: He said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight at Ramoth-gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, "I am like you, my people are like your people, and my horses are like your horses."

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
verses.decoded: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Please ask for the word of the LORD today.

verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Israel gathered about four hundred prophets together and said to them, Should I go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should I hold back? They said, Go ahead; because the Lord will deliver it into the king's hand.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.decoded: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not another prophet of the LORD here, so that we can ask him?

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.decoded: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, through whom we can ask the LORD; but I hate him because he does not prophesy good about me, but evil." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let the king not say that."

verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Israel called an officer and said, Quickly bring Micaiah, the son of Imlah, here.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, each sat on his throne, wearing their robes, in an empty area at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets spoke their prophecies in front of them.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.decoded: And Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, made iron horns for him and said, The LORD says, With these you will push the Syrians until you have destroyed them.

verses.kjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king’s hand.
verses.decoded: And all the prophets predicted the same thing, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be successful, because the LORD will give it into the king's hand.

verses.kjv: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
verses.decoded: And the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah said to him, 'Look now, the words of the prophets all speak good things to the king with one voice: please let your word be like the word of one of them, and say something good.'

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.decoded: And Micaiah said, As the LORD lives, I will speak whatever the LORD tells me.

verses.kjv: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.decoded: So he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micaiah, should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should we hold back? And he answered him, Go, and succeed, because the LORD will deliver it into the king's hand.

verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?
verses.decoded: And the king said to him, How many times must I urge you to tell me only what is true in the name of the LORD?

verses.kjv: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.decoded: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered on the hills, like sheep without a shepherd; and the LORD said, They have no leader; let each of them return to his home in peace.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.decoded: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy anything good about me, but only evil?

verses.kjv: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.decoded: And he said, Therefore, listen to the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the armies of heaven standing by him on his right and on his left.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, Who will convince Ahab to go up and be defeated at Ramoth-gilead? One suggested this way, and another suggested that way.

verses.kjv: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.decoded: Then a spirit came out and stood in front of the LORD and said, I will convince him.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to him, 'How?' He said, 'I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.' The LORD said, 'You will persuade him and succeed as well; go out and do it.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.decoded: So now, look, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these your prophets, and the LORD has spoken evil about you.

verses.kjv: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
verses.decoded: But Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, came close and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, 'Which way did the Spirit of the LORD leave me to speak to you?'

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.decoded: And Micaiah said, Look, you will see on that day when you go into a private room to hide yourself.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.decoded: The king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and bring him back to Amon, the city governor, and to Joash, the king’s son.

verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.decoded: And say, This is what the king says: Put this man in prison, and give him bread of suffering and water of suffering until I return safely.

verses.kjv: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.decoded: And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken through me. And he said, Listen, everyone, all of you.

verses.kjv: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you wear your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

verses.kjv: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.decoded: But the king of Syria ordered his thirty-two commanders who were in charge of his chariots, saying, Do not fight with anyone, whether they are low or high rank, except only with the king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.decoded: When the commanders of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, 'Surely this is the king of Israel.' Then they turned aside to attack him, and Jehoshaphat shouted.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the commanders of the chariots realized that it was not the king of Israel, they stopped chasing him and turned back.

verses.kjv: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.decoded: And a certain man shot an arrow randomly and struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor; so he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn your hand and take me out of the battle, because I am wounded."

verses.kjv: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.decoded: The battle grew more intense that day, and the king stayed in his chariot fighting against the Syrians. He died in the evening, and blood flowed from his wound into the middle of the chariot.

verses.kjv: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.decoded: A proclamation was made throughout the army around sunset, saying, Everyone return to your city, and everyone return to your own country.

verses.kjv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.decoded: So the king died, and they took him to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
verses.decoded: Someone washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armor; just as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The rest of the actions of Ahab, everything he did, the ivory house he built, and all the cities he constructed, are they not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Ahab died; and his son Ahaziah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat, the son of Asa, started to rule over Judah in the fourth year of King Ahab of Israel.

verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.kjv: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.decoded: He followed all the ways of Asa his father; he did not turn away from them, doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD. However, the high places were not removed, because the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Jehoshaphat's reign, his great power, and the wars he fought, are not they recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.decoded: He removed the remaining people who practiced sodomy, who were still in the land during the time of his father Asa.

verses.kjv: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
verses.decoded: At that time, there was no king in Edom; a governor ruled as king.

verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat built ships like those of Tarshish to sail to Ophir to get gold, but they did not go because the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

verses.kjv: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.decoded: Then Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants on the ships." But Jehoshaphat refused.

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, his father. Then his son Jehoram became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.decoded: Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, began to rule over Israel in Samaria during the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, and he ruled over Israel for two years.

verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.decoded: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the ways of his father, his mother, and Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.decoded: Because he served Baal and worshiped him, and he angered the LORD God of Israel, just like his father had done.
